title: M1DetectedEventMessage
description: Schema for MEDIATE Message M1 emitted by a Sentinel when an anomaly, attack, or abnormal event is detected. The NGSI-LD entity type is used by ComDeX for type-based subscription. Multi-typing is supported per ETSI GS CIM 009 v1.5.1 and later: an entity may carry one type (string) or several types (array).

type.description: NGSI-LD entity type(s) used as the detected anomaly or attack category for ComDeX subscription. Either a single type (string) or multiple types (array of strings) per NGSI-LD multi-typing (ETSI GS CIM 009 >= v1.5.1).

timestamp.description: Property. Date and time at which the anomaly, attack, or abnormal event was detected.

eventId.description: Property. Identifier of the detected event. It may be a UUID or another MEDIATE event identifier.

eventAssets.description: Relationship. List of asset entities associated with the detected event. A single event may involve one or more assets.

sentinelId.description: Relationship. Sentinel entity that detected the anomaly, attack, or abnormal event.

sentinelType.description: Property. Type/category of the Sentinel, for example hardware, software, edge, or cloud.

eventData.description: Property. Raw or structured data describing the detected event.

eventToolType.description: Property. List of tools, sensors, or sources involved in the detection. Examples: LIDAR, Camera, GNSS, Satellite.

severityVector.description: Property. Numeric severity vector provided by the Sentinel. The meaning of each position must be confirmed by the responsible partners.

mitigationAction.description: Property. Suggested mitigation action associated with the detected anomaly, attack, or abnormal event.

commentDetails.description: Property. Additional textual details about the detected anomaly, attack, or abnormal event.
